**Which role/module does this affect?**
e.g. Employer dashboard, TSP pipeline, Admin console, Funder portal, Learner UI

**What's the problem this solves?**
Describe the gap or friction this addresses — not just the feature itself.

**Proposed approach**
If you have one. Note any schema/migration impact, and whether it fits the
existing RBAC/ownership pattern described in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

**Out of scope reminder**
Billing is intentionally not being built yet (see README's Known gaps) —
please don't file billing feature requests without checking with the
project owner first.

**Additional context**
Anything else worth knowing.
